notes.title: Hotfix: Black screen on launch + Starting below welcome screen + holster setting
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Finally got a full fix for the black screen and welcome screen issues that have been hitting various users since the launch of the SWAT DLC. We apologise for all the inconvenience and want to thank all the members of the community in their help beta testing our solutions.

We've also included a new setting, found in the options menu under "Gameplay on Page 2":

Holster Depth Offset

This setting modifies how far away all the holster points sit from your body.

Hopefully that's all the major issues wrapped up for now so you all can return to enjoying the game :D

Let us know if there's anything else we can help with.
- The Gun Club VR Dev team

notes.title: Christmas Patch - HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Hey all! We're back from our holiday break and bring a quick hotfix for some issues that popped up with patch 1.0.29 as well as a new gun!
      
New Weapon:

 P30L

      
New Feature:

 Some default attachments are now removable and appear as attachments for their weapons in the upgrades menu (VSS and PSG scope, MK18 & MPX iron sights, P30L Match Weight)

      
Fixes:

 Capacity Upgrades should no longer break the spawning of more ammo
 Shotgun Speedloader becoming separated from itself when operating quickly
 Fixed Auto-Attach only working for the first attachment
 Stopped muzzle breaks from appearing in upgrades when the weapon doesn't support them

 Replaced some incorrect icons


Thank you for your patience over the break and we've been so glad to see so many of you enjoying our game. If you haven't already, come join us on our Discord Server! We are almost always active over there and are happy to hear feedback, take on suggestions and discuss new features for Gun Club with you all (as well as provide hints for a certain secret).

 ACR (Desert)
 Maxim 9
 PSG1

notes.title: Patch 1.0.21
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.21 is here with 5 new weapons, a couple of new attachments and some new; much requested options - including support for the Valve Index!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900476/d336576392c8a26c30373e2dfa2f8c0d240125fe.gif

New Weapons:

EF88 Assault Rifle
SKO Semi-Auto Shotgun
MP40 Submachine gun

And as voted by our Discord Community:

STG44 Assault Rifle
Uzi Submachine gun


New Attachments:

Tactical Pistol Stock
Vertical Foregrip


New Features:

Steam Input and Index Support
Rotational Bolt-locking added to relevant weapon i.e MP5, EF88 etc
Seated Mode and height adjustment Added
G17 & G18 lower rail now supports attachments (No mounted rail required)
(Sandbox) Can now rotate props as they’re being placed
(Sandbox) Added more props


New Options:
Added Stock Emulation Option for Two-Handed Tracking

On - Gun moves like stock is pressed against the shoulder
Hybrid - Same as “On” but only engages when the gun is lifted up the the shoulder which allows for hipfiring
Off - Gun follows the two hands directly


Added Grip Offset Option to disable controller offset (this lowers held items to where the real hand is located but can mean controller can clash when operating)

Off - Held items is where hand is location
Low - Held items are slightly above hand location
High - Held items are above the hand location


Added Setting to reduce the size of enemy health indicators

Off
Small
Large ( original size )


Added Toggle Grips Require Release option that restricts a toggled grip to only release when the action "Release Toggle Grip" is pulled. Useful for if you've rebound the Grip and Fire actions to the same button through Steam Inputs.

Bug Fixes:

Gun on the floor directly below can now be Far-Grabbed
Fire Particles should now follow targets when hit
Bayonets now effect targets in range again
Haptic Feedback intensified on Rift
Unintended UI Interaction will be blocked when operating weapon
Restarting Range will respawn destructibles
Fixed unhittable targets in Allied Window
Many more little fixes


We’re getting dug in to the next patch now which will see the winner of our previous Discord community weapon poll  - the Kriss Vector - added, as well as another handful of guns, attachments and features.

As always, if you have any suggestions or bug reports or just want to chat you can get in touch with us through our   Steam Forums, our Support Services or on our Discord Server!

notes.title: Gun Club VR 1.0.11 PC Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey guys its been awhile but we’re back to bring you all another pile of weapons and attachments to take out on the range in Patch 1.0.11 for the PC! 

New Weapons:

CZ Scorpion Evo - A modern SMG from the Czech Republic
Famas F1 - French assault rifle boasting an impressive rate of fire
6P9 - Soviet-era 9mm pistol with integrated silencer
WA2000 - Incredibly rare bullpup sniper rifle
Golden AK47 - Blinged out makeover of everyone’s favourite assault rifle


New Attachments:

Highmount Rail - Add a little bit of extra height to your rails, now purchasable outside of the sandbox! (Some attachments not compatible)
Tactical Red Dot Sight - A 4x zoomed RDS with 3 additional rails for extra customisation (Some attachments not compatible).
Angled Foregrip Another foregrip option with additional sleekness
3.25x Magnifier Scope The name says it all; except for its ability to flip out on a 90° angle


Other Additions and Bug Fixes:

Added option to hide/show your body (holster objects stay visible)
Added options to change how the HUD follows you.
Added hidden fruit spawns to every level
A wide range of optimisations across game modes and weapons
S&W629 more accurately displays its current ammo to the HUD
Aligned S&W629’s iron sights
Changed the handle on the M1918 A2 to now provide an extra foregrip position
Fixed the reciprocating charging handle on the M1918 A2 BAR (still not 100% accurate to real life operation but better)
Togglable weapon elements now save what state they were last in (ie. MK18 Iron sights)
Green glow shouldn’t appear over attachments when holding an item
Fixed up the textures on the 22x Scope
Many other minor fixes that we’ve lost track of


There’s still heaps more in the works so stay tuned and we’ll have more for you all soon. As always, if you have any suggestions or bug reports or just want to chat you can get in touch with us through our   Steam Forums, our Support Services or on our Discord Server!

Also one of our community members has set up and is running the unofficial Gun Club VR Subreddit!! Most of the content there so far has been PSVR-focused but if you're a Reddit user give them a look! We'll even make an appearance ourselves from time to time under the name GunClubDev.

notes.title: We're almost there! Early Access Update #5
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900476/3eb693ea94b5b689aea6a49a004fdb4d99cef081.png

Welcome to Gun Club VR’s biggest update yet! We’re super excited to announce that this update will prepare us for launch from Early Access. Read on to see what’s been added!

Sandbox
This abandoned missile silo has no limits, no rules; just grab any gun and start blowing stuff up. Select from a variety of destructible items (more being added regularly) to spawn and setup your very own scenario. Blow up walls, explode barrels, attach rockets to bits of rope or even spawn a concrete T-rex, just because you can. Let your imagination run wild with this no-holds-barred playpen.

Manual attachment system
Gain total control of your weapon’s rig by manually attaching rails, scopes, grips, flashlights - you name it. Intuitively navigate the upgrade menu (or sandbox’s) attachment library and mix and match to find the ultimate setup. For those of you that prefer a more hands off approach, auto-attach is still an option.

Sniper events
The Allied Range introduces an all new sniper mode for those with rifles. Snap on a scope and challenge your marksman skills in these dextrous sniper events - can you ensure the safety of the VIP?

Spray can livery system 
Give your guns a personal touch with splash of paint. Nothing says ‘come at me bro’ like a yellow indifferent emoji sprayed on your Glock. Select from multiple brush types, stencils and colours or import your own images to make your collection truly unique.

“Oh the grind!” (Money balance adjustment)
Thought earning money was too much of a grind? We heard you loud and clear and have rebalanced events to be more generous with cash rewards. “Yay!” That’s right Timmy, you’ll be fleshing out your arsenal in no time. And for those who already endured the grind, you’ll be retroactively awarded with what you would have earned had this new system been in place when you started. Look for the fat stack of cash on the gun case in the lobby!

User profiles
Sick of fighting over your Gun Club VR progress with your loved ones? Or perhaps you’re trying to run a reputable VR Arcade and are fed up with deleting config files? Well boy do we have the solution for you - multiple user profiles! Whether you want to start a fresh game and experience all the (new) magic that Gun Club VR has to offer or perhaps spec out in a different direction entirely, multiple user profiles have got your back with 4 slots of discreet storage action.   

Weapon profiles
With all of your fancy spray-painted & decked out guns you’ll be wanting some way to store them. Luckily, we thought of that too. Each gun now has up to four unique profiles so you can have that perfect configuration ready to go at the press of a button.

More action ranges
Ostentatiously called advanced “Action 2” ranges, these events step things up a notch from their “Action 1” brethren. You’ll now be weaving inside buildings, running up stairs, peering out windows and warping through back allies as you lay waste to any and all plywood that dares stand in your way.

New Weapons

AWSM
M1 Garand
De Lisle rifle
Quality of Life stuff

Players can now use the trigger buttons to pull slides without accidently gripping the weapons 
Operate the Slide Lock by pressing Left on the Thumbpad/stick
More target variety! 
More stuff we’ve forgotten about (seriously)
An update of this magnitude is probably more prone to bugs than usual, so if you do find anything please do be sure to post on the forums or send us your feedback directly via https://thebinarymill.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

Thanks for your continued support and we hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Gun Club VR Update 2
notes.notes:
We’ve uploaded a small update (0.3.99985) to address some minor bugs. While fixing these bugs we also made some improvements to the performance in the Range. We’re still working on the Allied weapons for the WWII update but wanted add in these revisions in the meantime.

In this build:

- It is now possible to initiate an Action Range Teleport with the interact button instead of waiting for the timer.
- Vive Controllers have refined grab detection to improve weapon interactions
- Vive users now have a alternate fade for teleporting that doesn’t incorporate the SteamVR view
- Scoreboard updates properly in the Action Ranges
- Performance improvements in the Range

Thanks for everyone’s input, please don’t hesitate to make any suggestions or let us know about any bugs you find.

notes.title: Gun Club VR Update 1
notes.notes:
Welcome to our first update post, apologies for being quiet so far but we've been deep in development of the WWII Allied Weapons Update which is planned for release in December.

That being said we've been keeping an eye on any suggestions and problems posted so far. So in the meantime we've prepared a small point release (0.3.99980) to address some bugs and also add in some additional functionality.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900476/5c3f4ea895ff9a2c19c969fa879052961dcfc913.gif

In this build:

- Triggers now move along with the index finger
- We've fixed up the fire mode on the TMP and also the incorrect operation of the charging handle.
- Vive users should notice Action ranges no longer momentarily show the SteamVR Room after teleporting.
- It is now possible to operate the weapons magazine during countdown
- Firing targets in the range are now unable to shoot during their popup animation and their shots won’t leave floating decals when hitting dynamic objects
- A supersampling option has been added in the Lobby Options panel ( from 0.7 -> 2.0 )
- Fixed the ability of Grenades to explode Red Barrels
- Other various smaller bug fixes


In the meantime while we work on the Allied Update and other features, please don’t hesitate to make any suggestions or let us know about any bugs you find we really appreciate the help.

We’d also like to thank to PS5Owner who alerted us to many of the bugs fixed in this build.
